subject: Re: Scheduling demo — Greencycle inference pilot (timeline change)
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@greencycle.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@greencycle.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — Greencycle inference pilot (timeline change)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the note and for the deck you sent last week. Quick update from our side: leadership just pushed through a sprint replan and product is reallocating headcount and budget away from the LLM/inference pilot for the next two quarters. That means we need to pause active evaluations for now.

Priya (copied) is the product lead and will confirm the scope of the pause — my expectation is that we should park the demo window rather than schedule something new.

Appreciate how fast you’ve been on this; can we put a hold and re-evaluate in ~8 weeks? If you want to preserve the materials, please send a short mutual action plan snapshot and we’ll pick up from there later.

Best,
Alex
Account Exec, Greencycle

[This email is intentionally short — travel and sprint planning caused a quick update.]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@greencycle.io>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@greencycle.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — Greencycle inference pilot (timeline change)

Alex —

Totally understand, thanks for the quick heads-up. Sorry to hear the sprint shuffle — that happens. I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan (current status + recommended next steps) and the short demo agenda so you have a clean snapshot to drop into your roadmap backlog.

Two quick asks so we preserve momentum without overburdening your team:
- If you can, confirm a rough target month for a check-in (e.g., mid-Nov or early-Jan). No need for a firm date — just a window.
- If preserving a small test dataset or sandbox access is helpful, we can provide a lightweight trial that requires zero setup from Priya’s team; happy to pause it immediately if you’d rather not.

I’ll mark the current demo window as tentative on our side and circle back in six weeks. Marissa and Ben are looped for any commercial/credits questions.

Thanks again — safe travels to anyone on the product side this week.

—Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Greencycle_MutualActionPlan_v1.docx; Redwood_DemoAgenda.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Scheduling demo — Greencycle inference pilot (timeline change)

Aditya / Ben —

Copied the thread into a quick internal note: Greencycle has reprioritized and asked for a pause. Two commercial points to consider before we archive:
1) Offer a six-week check-in cadence as Aditya proposed; set a reminder in HubSpot so follow-up is automatic.
2) Small goodwill credit? If we can offer a $2k credit or extended trial to keep Greencycle engaged without active work from Priya’s team, it usually helps restart conversations when priorities normalize.

Ben — any objections to the credit from renewals/BDR budget? Lauren, FYI in case this becomes an exception.

M

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Scheduling demo — Greencycle inference pilot (timeline change)

Marissa —

No objection to a small credit to keep them warm, provided we track it against GC-2026-0432 and route any spend to the trial pool. $2k seems reasonable. Please add the credit line to the mutual action plan doc and mark as conditional on re-engagement within 4 months.

Also agree with a six-week reminder — I’ll create a HubSpot task with the suggested follow-up window and include outreach templates.

Ben
Account Growth | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@greencycle.io>

Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — Greencycle inference pilot (timeline change)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — understood and totally fine to park this on your roadmap. Per internal alignment: we’ve added a six-week reminder for a short check-in and flagged a $2k trial credit tied to deal GC-2026-0432 (conditional on re-engagement within 4 months).

I’ve attached the updated mutual action plan with the credit line and a condensed agenda so your product team can file it with the sprint notes. If anything changes sooner, we’re available to run the demo remotely with minimal scheduling overhead.

Take care and we’ll talk in a few weeks.

Best,
Aditya Rao
